_comment: Story fixtures for the breaking-news board — the regression suite, not a placeholder.
GDELT failed six of six attempts and is recorded UNREACHABLE, so the board is built
against these and wired to the curated RSS feeds afterwards. Per D6 the fixtures ARE
the suite; the feed replaces the source, not the tests.
Chosen by CASE, the way the iptv capture is:
- a story near the corpus ceiling (every curated outlet carrying it)
- two stories within the tie epsilon, so the tied band is exercised
- a story with an UNCONSULTED event linkage, so null-not-zero is exercised
- a story nobody covered, which must score zero rather than being hidden

stories.headline: Fixture: summit concludes without agreement
stories.note: At the corpus ceiling on outlet breadth — 15 of 15 curated feeds.

stories.headline: Fixture: central bank holds rates
stories.note: Tied with story-tied-b inside the epsilon.

stories.headline: Fixture: port strike enters second week
stories.note: Tied with story-tied-a inside the epsilon.

stories.headline: Fixture: flooding displaces thousands
stories.note: The event index was unavailable — consulted-and-empty is NOT the same as checked-and-no.

stories.headline: Fixture: regional election result certified
stories.note: Nobody covered it. Scores zero, and is listed rather than hidden.
